７ Note
The Streaming API can be integrated either via Event Hubs or Azure Storage
Account.
1. Log on to Microsoft Defender portal
as a Security Administrator at a minimum.
2. Go to the Streaming API settings page
.
3. Click on Add.
4. Choose a name for your new settings.
5. Choose Forward events to Azure Event Hub.
6. You can select if you want to export the event data to a single Event Hub, or to
export each event table to a different Event Hubs in your Event Hubs namespace.
7. To export the event data to a single Event Hub, enter your Event Hub name and
your Event Hub Namespace resource ID.
To get your Event Hub Namespace resource ID, go to your Azure Event Hubs
namespace page on Azure
> Properties tab > copy the text under Resource ID:
8. Go to the Supported Microsoft Defender XDR event types in event streaming API
to review the support status of event types in the Microsoft 365 Streaming API.
9. Choose the events you want to stream and click Save.
